summary: Reads geometry files into POP GPU memory, including the native lossless .pop format plus OBJ, PLY, TOG, Houdini classic formats, and supported network URLs. It maps file geometry, colors, normals, texture coordinates, faces, line strips, and point data into POP attributes and primitives.

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Geometry file path or supported URL

key_params.name: inputcolorspace
key_params.note: Color space interpretation for incoming color data

key_params.name: inputreferencewhite
key_params.note: Reference white for incoming color data

key_concepts: File In POP reads supported geometry files or supported network URLs and converts the contents into a POP in GPU memory.
The native .pop format preserves POP primitive types, attributes, groups, and Dimension exactly.
OBJ imports support faces and line strips with texture coordinates and normals; polygons with more than three sides are triangulated.
PLY imports map vertex color fields into point Color and convert three- or four-sided faces to triangles/quads, while larger faces become closed line strips.
Refresh and Refresh Pulse control explicit file reloads, which is important when external files change while the network is running.
Input color-space and reference-white controls define how imported color attributes are interpreted before downstream POP processing.
common_gotchas: OBJ polygons with more than three sides are triangulated; PLY faces with more than four sides can become closed line strips.
Native .pop files can hold large GPU datasets; loading them can have a significant GPU-memory cost.
Network URLs are supported only for supported file types and reachable paths.
Reload pulses are needed when external files change but the node does not automatically re-read them.
